title: J-Cruise II Vortex TC-1

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Shoei J-Cruise II Vortex TC-1 is crafted for classic motorcycle enthusiasts seeking unrestricted peripheral sightlines. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1119g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~96 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Premium open face touring helmet with extended internal sun shield.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval head shapes; offers a roomier fit compared to the TC-10 due to open-face geometry.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced Integrated Matrix Plus (AIM+) 6-layer organic fiber and fiberglass composite shell paired with CWR-F2 3D injection-molded visor with Pinlock EVO lens inserts and vortex generators along the shield edges. The interior utilizes Dual-layer multi-density EPS with internal cooling channels and 3D Max-Dry custom cheek pad fitment with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Shoei J-Cruise II Vortex TC-1: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with CWR-F2 3D injection-molded visor with Pinlock EVO lens inserts and vortex generators along the shield edges and Dual-layer multi-density EPS with internal cooling channels and 3D Max-Dry custom cheek pad fitment. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Shoei's Open Face lineup, the J-Cruise II Vortex TC-1 brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Shoei J-Cruise II Vortex TC-1 represents Shoei's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~96 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Shoei J-Cruise II Vortex TC-1 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
